input.question: When was Austin City Hall built?

documents.text: Austin City Hall (Austin, Nevada) The Austin City Hall, at 90 South St. in Austin, Nevada, was built in 1920, when Austin was experiencing a revival after a period of decline, and served as a city hall and jail. It has also been known as Austin Station House, as Austin American Legion Hall, and as Austin VFW Hall. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2003. It was deemed significant for serving Austin during the early 20th century, a period of renewed growth and development. The building was transferred to the local Knights of Pythias chapter and has since been used for various community events and meetings.
